name: Steps / Stepper
summary: Passive horizontal or vertical ordered progress indicator with generated connectors, canonical upcoming/current/completed states, accessible state text, logical layout, and no implicit workflow navigation.

anatomy.name: connector
anatomy.description: Generated decorative connector between adjacent steps; horizontal layout draws before later items and vertical layout draws after earlier items.

anatomy.name: indicator
anatomy.description: Step number, icon, or completion mark.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Wraps the primary label, optional description, and accessible state text.

anatomy.name: state
anatomy.description: Visible or visually hidden text that exposes completion when the icon alone is decorative.

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.description: Compatibility alias for the primary title during migration; new implementations use steps__title.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Default step indicator and label size.

states.name: terminalConnectors
states.description: Horizontal layout hides the connector before the first step; vertical layout instead hides the connector after the last step.

states.name: completed
states.description: Completed step connector and indicator state.

states.name: done
states.description: Compatibility alias for completed state during migration; new implementations use steps__item--completed.

behavior.name: progressSemantics
behavior.description: Render a labelled ordered list and expose at most one current step without inventing a custom Step role.

behavior.name: orderedSequence
behavior.description: Steps should preserve a logical ordered sequence even when rendered horizontally or vertically.

behavior.name: orientation
behavior.description: Orientation changes visual layout only; an ordinary ordered list does not receive aria-orientation.

behavior.name: completedState
behavior.description: Completed is canonical and includes non-color state text; done remains a temporary CSS compatibility alias.

behavior.name: passiveByDefault
behavior.description: Steps has no implicit keyboard interaction, routing, validation, or roving focus. Interactive workflows compose native Link or Button controls in the owning target.

properties.name: orientation
properties.description: Selects the horizontal or vertical canonical layout without changing the ordered progress semantics.

accessibility: Use a labelled ordered list so the step sequence is understandable without visual layout.
Mark at most one current step with aria-current="step"; do not apply aria-orientation to an ordinary list.
Do not communicate completion only by color or an aria-hidden icon; include equivalent state text.
Keep DOM order and semantics identical across horizontal, vertical, localized, RTL, and narrow layouts.
Keep the base component passive. If a target makes steps navigable, compose native Links or Buttons and certify routing, validation, focus, and disabled behavior separately.

web.notes: Implemented as logical, overflow-safe ordered-list CSS with canonical completed/current/upcoming states and a temporary done/label compatibility bridge.

shopify.notes: Shopify Liquid can render ordered passive steps with the same class contract while the owning workflow controls navigation, validation, and announcements.
